questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

We must / take care / of one other / in times of crisis.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"of one other". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is in the phrase **"of one other". **
 
• The correct phrase should be **"of each other" **when referring to mutual support or actions between two or more parties.
 
• **"Each other" **is used when two entities are involved, and **"one another" **is traditionally used for more than two, but the sentence indicates a general situation implying two or more people supporting each other during crises, hence **"each other" **or **"one another" **could fit, but not **"one other".**
 
• The error changes the meaning of the sentence by making it grammatically incorrect and causing confusion about the intended message of mutual support.
 
• The corrected sentence would read: **"We must take care of each other in times of crisis." **ensuring clarity and correctness in conveying the importance of mutual support during difficult times.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• We must - This segment sets the tone for imperative or strong advice, suggesting an action that needs to be taken.
 
 
• It is grammatically correct.
 
 
 
• take care - This phrase is correctly used in this context to imply looking after or supporting one another.
 
 
• It stands as a common expression for showing concern and kindness.
 
 
 
• in times of crisis - Refers to periods of difficulty or emergency.
 
 
• This segment correctly indicates when the action of taking care of one another is especially emphasized.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Bibiya asked the doctor if she could get the discharge in the morning.

options.text: Bibiya asked the doctor, "Can I get the discharge in the morning?"
Bibiya asked the doctor, "How can I get the discharge in the morning?"
Bibiya asked the doctor, "Could I have got the discharge in the morning?"
Bibiya asked the doctor, "If I can get the discharge in the morning?"

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Bibiya asked the doctor, "Can I get the discharge in the morning?"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To convert a sentence from indirect to direct speech, it's important to restore the original spoken form of the question or statement.
 
• The original sentence is indirect speech where Bibiya is inquiring about the possibility of getting discharged in the morning.
 
• **"Can I get the discharge in the morning?"** directly represents Bibiya's inquiry in her exact spoken words, maintaining the structure of a question.
 
• The use of **"Can"** instead of** "Could"** in the direct speech captures the direct inquiry regarding the ability or possibility of an action occurring.
 
• In converting to direct speech, question marks are reintroduced, and the sentence is enclosed in quotation marks to signify direct speech.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2) "Bibiya asked the doctor, 'How can I get the discharge in the morning?'" implies Bibiya was asking for the procedure or the way to get discharged, which the original sentence does not suggest.
 
 
• The focus is on the possibility, not the method.
 
 
 
• Option 3) "Bibiya asked the doctor, 'Could I have got the discharge in the morning?'" uses past perfect which erroneously suggests she's asking about a possibility that is already past and not a future possibility.
 
• Option 4) "Bibiya asked the doctor, 'If I can get the discharge in the morning?'" does not correctly format the sentence as a direct question.
 
 
• It presents a conditional thought when quoted, which is not aligned with the structure of a direct inquiry.

questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

It is wrong to make accusations __without will have any proof.__

options.text: without to be have any proof

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"without having any proof". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence needs grammatical correction to convey the idea of presenting accusations without possessing any proof.
 
• The phrase **"will have any proof"** is incorrect and does not follow grammar rules for expressing actions that are not supported by evidence.
 
• Option 4, **"without having any proof," **correctly uses the **gerund ("having") **to express the possession or the existence of proof in a grammatically correct manner.
 
• The use of **"having" **after **"without" **is a standard construction in English for indicating the absence of something.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) "without has any proof" uses an incorrect verb form ("has") after "without," which doesn't conform to standard English grammar.
 
• Option 2) "without being have any proof" is grammatically incorrect because "being have" is not a correct verb form or construction in English.
 
• Option 3) "without to be have any proof" is also grammatically incorrect because "to be have" does not follow the correct grammatical construction in English for indicating the absence of something, especially proof in this context.

questions.question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Social organisation where males are heads of families
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "Patriarchy". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Patriarchy refers to a social system in which men hold primary power and predominate in roles of political leadership, moral authority, social privilege, and control of property.
 
• In the context of a family structure, it specifically denotes a situation where fathers or elder males are the authority figures.
 
• This system is historically prevalent across various cultures and societies, where men are considered the head of the family and lineage.
 
• Patriarchy also implies the inheritance of property, titles, or status through the male line, thereby reinforcing male dominance in societal roles and family leadership.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 2". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Matriarchy :** A social organizational form where females, especially mothers, have the central roles of political leadership, moral authority, and control over property.

 
 
• It is the opposite of patriarchy.
 
 
 
• **Polygamy : **A marital practice in which an individual has more than one spouse simultaneously.
 
 
• Polygamy can take the form of either polygyny (a man having multiple wives) or polyandry (a woman having multiple husbands).
 
• It does not pertain directly to the leadership structure within families or societies.
 
 
 
• **Hierarchy : **Refers to a system or organization in which people or groups are ranked one above the other according to status or authority.
 
 
• While it can relate to social structures, hierarchy itself does not specifically imply a male-dominated system nor is it exclusive to social organization based on gender.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

He ordered the police to pursue the robber and his gang.

options.text: The police were ordered to pursue the robber and his gang.
Order the police to pursue the robber gang.
Pursue the robber and gang were the orders by police.
The robber and gang were pursued.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"The police were ordered to pursue the robber and his gang."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To convert a sentence into passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence, and the subject of the active sentence is typically added at the end with **"by" **or sometimes omitted if it's clear or irrelevant.
 
• The original sentence, **"He ordered the police to pursue the robber and his gang," **has **"the police" **as the object receiving the action of being ordered.
 
 
• Thus, they become the subject in the passive construction.
 
 
 
• Option 1 correctly follows the structure for converting active to passive voice, bringing **"the police" **to the beginning of the sentence and properly using the verb **"were ordered" **to indicate the passive voice.
 
• The rest of the sentence, **"to pursue the robber and his gang," **remains unchanged, as it describes the action the police were ordered to perform.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2) "Order the police to pursue the robber gang." is an imperative sentence and does not convert the original sentence into passive voice.
 
• Option 3) "Pursue the robber and gang were the orders by police." is an incorrectly structured sentence and does not convey the original meaning accurately in passive voice.
 
• Option 4) "The robber and gang were pursued." simplifies the action to its outcome but removes the original aspect of an order being given, thus not accurately representing the original sentence in passive form.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

I don't buy it

options.text: Only good decisions can be agreed on
I do not like to buy

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "I am not convinced". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"I don't buy it" **is commonly used in English to express skepticism or disbelief in what someone has said or in the credibility of a particular claim.
 
• It does not relate to a literal action of buying something, but rather metaphorically implies that the speaker is not **"purchasing" **the idea or agreeing with the proposition.
 
• This phrase is often used in informal conversations to convey doubt or to challenge the validity of an argument or statement.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Purchasing should be controlled" **is a literal statement about buying behavior and is not related to expressing disbelief.
 
• **"Only good decisions can be agreed on"** is a statement of preference or principle, not a phrase used to express skepticism.
 
• **"I do not like to buy"** expresses a personal dislike towards the act of purchasing, which is unrelated to the idiom's metaphorical meaning of not being convinced.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Plastic pollution is ______ the oceans' ecosystem, but humanity doesn't take serious action against it.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "affecting". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank in the sentence requires a verb that describes the action plastic pollution is having on the oceans' ecosystem.
 
• The word **"affecting" **means having an effect on; making a difference to, which fits appropriately in the context of the statement as it describes the impact of plastic pollution on the ecosystem.
 
• The terms "deciding," "aiming," and "making" do not accurately describe the direct impact that plastic pollution has on the ecosystems.
 
• Using **"affecting" **correctly denotes a negative influence or alteration, which aligns with the general concern about plastic pollution's impact on environmental health.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is ** "Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Deciding" **means making a choice among several options, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **"Aiming" **is to direct or point something at a target, which also does not suit the context of the impact of pollution on the ecosystem.
 
• **"Making" **conveys the act of producing, constructing, or creating something, but in this sentence, the correct term needs to imply an effect or influence.

questions.question:

• For example, he is a native of Australia, implying he was born there.
 
 
 
• **Logical: **means relating to or of the nature of logic. (तार्किक).

questions.question: What is the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'autonomy' from the passage?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Dependence". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'autonomy' **in the context of the passage suggests the ability to make one's own decisions or having independence, particularly in the context of learning at one’s own pace.
 
• An antonym is a word that has the opposite meaning of another word.
 
• Therefore, the opposite of having the ability to make one's own decisions (autonomy) would be reliance on others to make decisions for you, which is captured by the word **'Dependence'.**
 
• **'Dependence' **signifies a state where someone relies on or needs something else; it contrasts with autonomy's emphasis on independence and self-direction.
 
• Considering virtual learning's advantage allows for self-paced learning, highlighting autonomy, the contrast would be a learning format where students are dependent on a structured schedule and possibly direct oversight.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Dependence."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Preference implies a greater liking for one alternative over others.
 
 
• It does not directly relate to autonomy or its opposite, making it an unsuitable option.
 
 
 
• Liberty is similar in meaning to autonomy, as it also deals with freedom and independence, making it a synonym rather than an antonym.
 
• Availability refers to being able to be used or obtained, which is irrelevant to the concept of autonomy or its direct opposite.

questions.question: What is the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'retention' from the passage?
questions.solution:

• The word **'retention' **in the context of the passage refers to the act of keeping or maintaining something, such as the ability to keep students engaged and enrolled in courses until completion.
 
• An antonym is a word that has the opposite meaning of another word.
 
• Therefore, the opposite of keeping or maintaining something (retention) would be the act of giving up or releasing something, which is encapsulated by the word 'Relinquishment'.
 
• 'Relinquishment' signifies the act of voluntarily giving up, releasing, or abandoning something, making it the direct opposite of retention, which implies holding on to or keeping.
 
• The passage discusses how online courses are associated with higher retention rates, implying students continue their courses until completion.
 
• The opposite scenario would involve students abandoning or discontinuing their courses, therefore, making 'Relinquishment' the correct antonym.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**

• Perception refers to the way in which something is regarded, understood, or interpreted.
 
 
• It does not directly relate to the concept of retaining or its opposite.
 
 
 
• Preventive is an adjective that describes something designed to stop something bad from happening.
 
 
• While it talks about prevention, it doesn't directly contrast with the idea of retention or keeping.
 
 
 
• Retaining is actually a synonym of retention, as it also means to keep or hold on to something.
